name: Cherry Blossom Survival Starter House
description: A starter house in plain wood with a pink roof and two raised farm plots attached at the side. You get a living space, a covered porch and crop beds with stairs between them. Common wood blocks throughout, so it works from day one. House and food supply in one build.

subBuilds.description: Create this design on the back.
Come to the front side again.
Place the water on the stairs.
